zones.name: Low density residential zone
zones.purpose: The purpose of the Low density residential zone is to provide for: a. a variety of low density dwelling types, including dwelling houses; and b. community uses, and small-scale services, facilities and infrastructure, to support local residents. Precincts: Acreage, Large suburban, Small acreage, Small lot, Suburban, Village.
zones.typical: Dwelling house is accepted development; dual occupancy (auxiliary unit) is accepted subject to requirements; multiple dwellings need code assessment within precinct density limits (Table 5.5.5.1).

zones.name: Low-medium density residential zone
zones.purpose: The purpose of the Low-medium density residential zone is to provide for: a. a variety of dwelling types, including dwelling houses and low to medium density multiple dwellings; and b. community uses, and small-scale services, facilities and infrastructure, to support local residents. Precincts: Apartment, Townhouse.
zones.typical: Dwelling house is accepted development; multiple dwellings need code assessment; dual occupancy is accepted subject to requirements in the Townhouse precinct on 500 m² or more (Table 5.5.7.1).

zones.name: Medium density residential zone
zones.purpose: The purpose of the Medium density residential zone is to provide for: a. medium density multiple dwellings; and b. community uses, and small-scale services, facilities and infrastructure, to support local residents. Precincts: High rise, Medium rise.
zones.typical: Multiple dwellings (apartments) need code assessment; dwelling house is accepted development (Table 5.5.8.1).

zones.name: Emerging community zone
zones.purpose: The local government purpose of the Emerging community zone code is to protect the future use of land for urban purposes.
zones.typical: Dwelling house is accepted development; multiple dwellings are not listed in Table 5.5.3.1, so they are impact assessable.

zones.name: Rural residential zone
zones.purpose: The purpose of the Rural residential zone is to provide for residential uses and activities on large lots, including lots for which the local government has not provided infrastructure and services. Precincts: Carbrook, Cottage rural, Park living, Park residential.
zones.typical: Levels of assessment: not loaded yet – see Part 5.5 of the Logan Planning Scheme 2015.

rules.title: Water resource catchments overlay

rules.title: Waterway wetlands overlay

rules.title: Transport noise corridor (OM-12)

rules.title: Local plan
rules.code: Part 7 local plan code (the relevant plan) and Part 5.9 tables of assessment
rules.note: A local plan applies. Its tables of assessment (Part 5.9) can change the level of assessment set by the zone, for example in the Loganholme and Loganlea local plans.

rules.level: Impact assessment below the lot-size thresholds in the items; complying lots are expected to be code assessable (not shown in the schedule; verify).

items.label: Impact assessment thresholds
items.value: Impact assessment where a reconfigured lot is: (A) if the entirety of all frontages is within 300m walking distance (was 200m before v37) of the nearest point of a Centre-zone-category site(s) with combined area >2,000m2 - less than 300m2; (B) otherwise - less than 400m2, or less than 600m2 for a rear lot. Also volumetric subdivision not tied to a building. Benchmarks: Subdivision code, LDR zone code, prescribed secondary code. Compliant (larger) lots are expected to be code assessable - not shown in the schedule, verify.
